text: Long ago a young man named Giovanni Guasconti. <break time="0.8s" /> Left his home in the south of Italy. <break time="0.8s" /> And came to Padua. <break time="0.8s" /> To pursue his studies. <break time="0.8s" /> At its ancient and famous university. <break time="0.8s" /> Having only a few coins in his pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> He took a high and gloomy chamber. <break time="0.8s" /> In an old mansion. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had once belonged to a noble family of Padua. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking down from his window. <break time="0.8s" /> Giovanni saw a garden of rare plants. <break time="0.8s" /> In whose center stood the ruin of a marble fountain. <break time="0.8s" /> That still sent up its sparkling water. <break time="0.8s" /> A soft gurgling rose to his window. <break time="0.8s" /> And made him feel. <break time="0.8s" /> As if the fountain were an immortal spirit. <break time="0.8s" /> Singing its song endlessly. <break time="0.8s" /> Without heeding the changes around it. <break time="0.8s" /> Beside the fountain grew a shrub with purple blossoms. <break time="0.8s" /> Each of which had the luster of a gem. <break time="0.8s" /> And the whole was so bright. <break time="0.8s" /> That it seemed able to illuminate the garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Even had there been no sunshine. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon a tall, thin, sallow man. <break time="0.8s" /> In a scholars black gown. <break time="0.8s" /> Came into the garden. <break time="0.8s" /> And examined each plant. <break time="0.8s" /> With a cold, intent gaze. <break time="0.8s" /> As though reading its innermost secrets. <break time="0.8s" /> Though his hands were gloved. <break time="0.8s" /> He avoided even their scent. <break time="0.8s" /> And when he reached the purple shrub. <break time="0.8s" /> He placed a mask over his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> As if its beauty concealed a deadly malice. <break time="0.8s" /> He called for his daughter Beatrice. <break time="0.8s" /> A girl as radiant as the blossoms themselves. <break time="0.8s" /> Who bent over the shrub without fear. <break time="0.8s" /> Embraced it, and whispered. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, my sister. <break time="0.8s" /> Your breath is the breath of life to me.
